analysis.one_line_summary: A young woman showcases her voluminous layered blowout hairstyle outdoors while posing to a rhythmic beat.
analysis.full_description: A short aesthetic UGC clip featuring a young woman with voluminous, dark, layered hair styled in a bouncy blowout. She holds the camera in selfie mode outside under a covered driveway or carport with cars parked in the background, swaying slightly and posing confidently. Text on screen reads 'this is your sign to get those layers'. No styling tools are physically shown in the clip; the video serves as hair inspiration demonstrating the final result of a layered blowout.
